to implement such programmes of the Rehabilitation
of  Persons,  Properties  and  Industries  Authority
established  under  section  2  of  the  repealed  Act
approved by the Cabinet of Ministers prior to the
date of commencement of this Act, until such time as
such programmes may be discontinued;
to facilitate the provision of other forms of assistance
provided  by  other  person  or  body  of  persons,
including restitution, rehabilitation, administration
and other assistance, and welfare services including
health  services,  psychosocial  support,  educational
and vocational training programmes, to the aggrieved
persons;
to appoint and exercise disciplinary control over or
